name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 3 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2025-11-01, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.59 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
